title: PV Monitoring & Datalogger Price in Pakistan 2026 — Solar Monitoring System, WiFi / GSM String Logger Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete buyer guide to PV monitoring systems and dataloggers in Pakistan 2026. Covers WiFi, GSM and RS485 string loggers, NEPRA net metering data requirements, Performance Ratio calculation, real-time fault alerts, and PKR prices for all tiers from residential WiFi dongles to IEC 61724-compliant industrial dataloggers.
